messages:
ellie: FYI CedarWave — sudden drop in embed/QA calls last 10 days, but we just got a procurement contact ping about proof-of-concept pricing. weird mix. can we triage?

diego: the mix of usage drop + procurement ping is usually a sign of a competitive chew. do we know which teams dropped off?

ellie: infra team stopped hitting batch embeddings; product team still active for analytics. quick metrics: 
```
Last 30d: total calls -24%
Embeddings jobs -61%
Chat sessions -6%
Active seats (30d) 42 -> 36
```
no open support tickets.

mara: :eyes: thanks. who is the procurement contact? any RFP or security checklist attached?

ellie: procurement lead is "G. Patel" (new to account). they mentioned evaluating a competitor that claims "lower token costs + federated connector". they attached an initial security questionnaire (used our SOC2 link).

ps-ops-bot: [auto-alert] renewal-risk: usage_decrease detected for CedarWave (drop threshold exceeded). Notifying assigned CSMs.

diego: good to know. ellie, please drop last 3 call notes and champion list here. i'll reach out to the product team for a feature delta doc.

ellie: call notes pasted: "23-02 sync: champion (Ana L.) still loves latency and streaming. infra lead says they're evaluating cost per-embed. procurement asked for vendor comparison and data residency statement."

ellie: champions: Ana L. (Platform Eng), Marcus P. (Data Science lead), Sophie R. (Head of Analytics)

jonah: any sign they spun up PoC infra of the competitor? (IPs, domains, slack traces?)

ellie: no direct infra evidence yet. procurement looped in a reseller; flagged NDA request.

mara: propose we: 1) offer a 30d embed-cost pilot (metered) 2) schedule exec 20-min check-in with Sophie & Ana 3) provide a concise feature/ops delta doc vs competitor. owners?

diego: I'll own #1 pricing pilot outreach. ETA EOD PST today to send proposal.

jonah: I'll do the exec check-in scheduling (put on Sophie+Ana calendars), aim for next week.

ellie: I can stitch together the comparison doc — will pull token-cost calc, KV cache advantage, and our VPC options. need product sign-off for the kernel/quantization claims.

mara: call out security questions we should proactively answer: KMS/HSM, data residency, deletion SLA. also prepare a teardown of likely feature gaps competitor is selling (e.g., federated connector vs our private deployment options).

ellie: noted. attaching the procurement email snippet: "seeking 3 vendor quotes, focus on per-embed price and regional deployment; timeline: decision in 6 weeks."

diego: quick ask — can we run a one-off analytics job to show cost delta if they switched 50k monthly embeddings? if so pls add numbers to the proposal.

jonah: re: champions, Ana has been responsive to engineering best practices. i'd push for short working session (30m) to show perf numbers vs competitor claim.

ps-ops-bot: [reminder] renewal_watchlist updated: CedarWave -> priority=high; alert window next_check=72h.

ellie: plan recap: diego = pricing pilot outreach (EOD), jonah = schedule exec check-in, ellie = draft comparison & security answers + paste to thread, mara = coordinate product sign-off.

mara: perfect. cancellation risk if we go quiet here. call for a 48h cadence until decision. :thumbsup:

diego: sending initial outreach now. ping me if you want to join the call.

ellie: adding meeting placeholder and will attach draft doc when ready (target: tomorrow AM).

jonah: scheduling note sent to Sophie & Ana, waiting confirm.

ellie: thanks team — will update thread with any procurement replies.
